_meta.title: D&D 5e class features — the mechanically-expressible subset (all 12 base classes)
_meta.license: CC-BY-4.0 (SRD 5.2.1 content; rules text paraphrased, not reproduced verbatim)
why: CharacterData has carried a `features` list since the first commit and NOTHING
read it: `grep -rn class_features components/ agents/ core/` returned zero
production hits. So a Barbarian and a Wizard of the same level fought
identically apart from their stats — no Rage, no Sneak Attack, no Second Wind.
These entries are DATA, not code, for the same reason surgebinding.json is:
the lesson of plan 3.1b was that a new ability should be a JSON entry, not a
new Python class. Adding a feature means adding an object here whose effect
nodes the engine already knows how to execute.
Coverage was raised from 7 features / 6 classes to every base class having at
least one authored feature, honestly split: `executable` features write real
engine state through the effect nodes below; `data-only` features (no effects,
or activation `passive`/`utility`) are granted and tracked but apply no state
yet; and whole subsystems that these nodes cannot express are listed in

schema.id: stable key; also the ACTION_REGISTRY name when `activation` is an action
schema.classes: which character_class values grant it (lowercase); [] = any
schema.min_level: level at which the feature is granted
schema.activation: action | bonus_action | reaction | free | passive | on_hit
schema.trigger: for on_hit features: the condition that must hold (see TRIGGERS)
schema.effects: list of effect nodes; see EFFECT NODES in class_features.py

effect_nodes.grant_action: add an action/bonus action/reaction to the economy
effect_nodes.extra_attack_damage: arm extra dice on the next hit (Sneak Attack, smites)
effect_nodes.inspiration_die: hand an ally a die for one roll (Bardic Inspiration)
effect_nodes.save_or_condition: target makes a save or gains a 5e condition
effect_nodes.ability_score_bonus: raise one ability SCORE by a flat amount
effect_nodes.temp_hp: grant Temporary Hit Points (does not stack)
effect_nodes.advantage: grant Advantage on a stated roll ({on:'saving_throw',ability:..} or {on:'attack'})

coverage_status: executable = applies engine state via an effect node and is unit-tested
activated executable features are also wired into ACTION_REGISTRY so a turn can select them
on_hit executable features ride the same arming path as Sneak Attack / Divine Smite
passive executable features apply through ClassFeatureEngine.apply_passives() (unit-tested);
the combat-start call site (DnDEngineWrapper) is a one-line follow-up outside this change's scope
data-only = granted and tracked (synced to entity.class_features) but no engine effect yet

needs_subsystem.reason: replaces the whole stat block with a Beast form; needs a polymorph/form subsystem, not an effect node
Flurry of Blows, Patient Defense, Step of the Wind and Stunning Strike all spend Focus Points from a pool that is not modeled
Font of Magic and Metamagic modify a spell mid-cast and spend Sorcery Points; needs a spell-modification layer
short-rest slot recharge and a single escalating slot level per rest; a distinct slot model from the standard progression
a selectable catalog of always-on/utility invocations and per-rest high-level spell casts; needs an invocation registry

needs_subsystem.system: Full spellcasting progression / spell slots by class
needs_subsystem.reason: prepared-spell lists and per-class slot tables (Bard, Cleric, Druid, Paladin, Ranger, Sorcerer, Warlock, Wizard) are not represented here; cast_spell exists but per-class slot growth is not
a d20 random-effect table triggered by casting; needs its own surge resolver (a subclass feature, not in the base SRD classes)
calls for GM/plane adjudication with a percentile-then-automatic success; needs an intervention subsystem
Uncanny Dodge, Deflect Attacks, Cutting Words, Countercharm and Indomitable fire off ANOTHER creature's roll/damage; needs a reaction-interrupt hook the turn loop does not expose
Expertise, Jack of All Trades and Reliable Talent change ability-check math; needs proficiency doubling / floors in the checks pipeline

deliberately_absent: Extra Attack — components/combat/multiattack.py is another agent's file.
Subclass features (Battle Master maneuvers, Assassinate, ...) — the base
class features had to exist first. Reckless Attack's downside (attackers gain
advantage against you) and durations that refresh each turn are not modeled.

features.name: Second Wind
features.description: Regain 1d10 + fighter level hit points as a bonus action.
features.quote: You have a limited well of stamina you can draw on to protect yourself from harm. On your turn, you can use a bonus action to regain hit points equal to 1d10 + your fighter level.

features.name: Action Surge
features.description: Take one additional action on your turn.
features.quote: Starting at 2nd level, you can push yourself beyond your normal limits for a moment. On your turn, you can take one additional action.

features.name: Rage
features.description: Bonus damage on Strength melee attacks and resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage.
features.quote: On your turn, you can enter a rage as a bonus action. While raging you gain bonus damage when you make a melee weapon attack using Strength, and you have resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.
features.ends_when: you have not attacked a hostile creature nor taken damage since your last turn

features.name: Sneak Attack
features.description: Extra damage once per turn when you have advantage, or when an ally is next to the target.
features.quote: Once per turn, you can deal extra damage to one creature you hit with an attack if you have advantage on the attack roll. You don't need advantage if another enemy of the target is within 5 feet of it.

features.name: Divine Smite
features.description: Expend a spell slot on a melee weapon hit for extra radiant damage.
features.quote: When you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack, you can expend one spell slot to deal radiant damage to the target, in addition to the weapon's damage. The extra damage is 2d8 for a 1st-level spell slot, plus 1d8 for each spell level higher than 1st, to a maximum of 5d8.

features.name: Bardic Inspiration
features.description: Give an ally a die they can add to one roll.
features.quote: You can use a bonus action on your turn to choose one creature other than yourself within 60 feet of you who can hear you. That creature gains one Bardic Inspiration die, a d6.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Turn Undead
features.description: Undead within 30 feet must make a Wisdom save or be frightened.
features.quote: As an action, you present your holy symbol and speak a prayer censuring the undead. Each undead that can see or hear you within 30 feet of you must make a Wisdom saving throw. If the creature fails its saving throw, it is turned for 1 minute or until it takes any damage.

features.name: Danger Sense
features.description: Advantage on Dexterity saving throws.
features.quote: You gain an uncanny sense of when things aren't as they should be. You have Advantage on Dexterity saving throws unless you have the Incapacitated condition.

features.name: Reckless Attack
features.description: Attack with abandon for advantage on Strength attack rolls (attackers also gain advantage against you — downside not modeled).
features.quote: When you make your first attack roll on your turn, you can decide to attack recklessly. Doing so gives you Advantage on attack rolls using Strength until the start of your next turn, but attack rolls against you have Advantage during that time.

features.name: Fast Movement
features.description: Your speed increases by 10 feet while you aren't wearing heavy armor.
features.quote: Your speed increases by 10 feet while you aren't wearing Heavy armor.

features.name: Primal Champion
features.description: Your Strength and Constitution scores increase by 4, to a maximum of 25.
features.quote: You embody primal power. Your Strength and Constitution scores increase by 4, to a maximum of 25.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Divine Spark
features.description: Focus divine energy to restore 1d8 + Wisdom hit points (the harm branch is not modeled here).
features.quote: As a Magic action, you point your Holy Symbol at another creature and focus divine energy at it. Roll 1d8 and add your Wisdom modifier. You either restore Hit Points to the creature equal to that total or force it to make a Constitution saving throw for damage.
features.note: Shares the Channel Divinity use pool with Turn Undead in the SRD; here each has its own counter.

features.name: Blessed Strikes: Divine Strike
features.description: Once per turn, your weapon hit deals an extra 1d8 radiant damage.
features.quote: Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with an attack roll using a weapon, you can cause the target to take an extra 1d8 Radiant damage.

features.name: Elemental Fury: Primal Strike
features.description: Once per turn, your weapon or Beast-form hit deals an extra 1d8 elemental damage (Fire chosen here).
features.quote: Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with an attack roll using a weapon or a Beast form's attack in Wild Shape, you can cause the target to take an extra 1d8 Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder damage.

features.name: Fighting Style: Defense
features.description: While wearing armor, you gain a +1 bonus to Armor Class.
features.quote: Defense. While you are wearing armor, you gain a +1 bonus to Armor Class.
features.note: Fighting Style is a choice; Defense is authored as the representative option.

features.name: Unarmored Movement
features.description: Your speed increases by 10 feet while unarmored (the base value; it scales higher by level in the SRD).
features.quote: Your speed increases by 10 feet while you aren't wearing armor or wielding a Shield. This bonus increases when you reach certain Monk levels.

features.name: Lay On Hands
features.description: Draw on a pool of healing power to restore hit points.
features.quote: You have a pool of healing power that replenishes when you finish a Long Rest. With that pool, you can restore a total number of Hit Points equal to five times your Paladin level. As a Bonus Action, you can touch a creature and restore Hit Points to it.
features.note: The 5×level HP pool is abstracted as 5 uses of ~level HP each (5×level total).

features.name: Radiant Strikes
features.description: Your melee or unarmed hits carry an extra 1d8 radiant damage.
features.quote: When you hit a target with an attack roll using a Melee weapon or an Unarmed Strike, the target takes an extra 1d8 Radiant damage.

features.name: Tireless
features.description: Give yourself 1d8 + Wisdom temporary hit points.
features.quote: As a Magic action, you can give yourself a number of Temporary Hit Points equal to 1d8 plus your Wisdom modifier (minimum of 1). You can use this action a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier.

features.name: Roving
features.description: Your speed increases by 10 feet while you aren't wearing heavy armor.
features.quote: Your Speed increases by 10 feet while you aren't wearing Heavy armor. You also have a Climb Speed and a Swim Speed equal to your Speed.

features.name: Steady Aim
features.description: Give yourself advantage on your next attack roll (your speed becomes 0 for the turn — that cost is not modeled).
features.quote: As a Bonus Action, you give yourself Advantage on your next attack roll on the current turn. You can use this feature only if you haven't moved during this turn, and after you use it, your Speed is 0 until the end of the current turn.

features.name: Innate Sorcery
features.description: Unleash your innate magic: advantage on the attack rolls of your spells (the +1 spell save DC is not modeled).
features.quote: As a Bonus Action, you can unleash that magic for 1 minute, during which the spell save DC of your Sorcerer spells increases by 1 and you have Advantage on the attack rolls of Sorcerer spells you cast.

features.name: Eldritch Invocation: Eldritch Mind
features.description: Advantage on Constitution saving throws to maintain concentration.
features.quote: You have Advantage on Constitution saving throws that you make to maintain Concentration.
features.note: One Eldritch Invocation option; the invocation catalog itself is a subsystem (see needs_subsystem).

features.name: Arcane Recovery
features.description: Recover expended spell slots on a short rest. Recorded so a Wizard is not featureless; the mechanic needs the spell-slot subsystem (see needs_subsystem).
features.quote: When you finish a Short Rest, you can choose expended spell slots to recover. The spell slots can have a combined level equal to no more than half your Wizard level (round up).
